Nimm einen Satz, der dir wichtig ist. Wa: Pick a sentence that matters to you. What exactly does it claim? What reasons support it? Here you can trace a correction we made to our own text.
One sentence can raise several questions. “We should do this because it helps” expresses a value judgment and an assumption about what works. Examine them separately.
Was wurde beobachtet oder historisch bel: What was observed or documented in historical sources? Under what conditions does the finding hold? What observation would count against it?
Aus welchen Definitionen und Voraussetzu: Which definitions and assumptions does the conclusion follow from? Does each step hold? Is there a counterexample under the same assumptions?
Welchen Wert vertreten wir? Wessen Inter: What value are we defending? Whose interests does it affect? Can we justify it in a difficult case?
Welche Stelle oder Erfahrung stützt die: Which passage or experience supports this reading? What other interpretation accounts for it just as well?
Was macht das Bild verständlich? Wo würd: What does the image help us understand? Where would a literal reading lead us astray?
Leave a record of your reasoning.
Halte eine Aussage und ihren Geltungsber: Write down a claim and where it applies. Give your best reason, the strongest objection and a condition that would change your view. If a crucial source or perspective is missing, record exactly what remains open.
Aus vorhandenen Befunden kann eine neue: Existing findings can suggest a new hypothesis. Make a prediction and ask what observation might distinguish it from a competing explanation.
Wenn du eine Änderung einreichst, entsch: When you submit a revision, the maintainer decides what to publish. For each correction, readers should be able to trace the earlier wording, the reason for changing it and the new version.
